24 No 8
MOST IMMEDIATE
No. 55/1/1/80-Cab.
GOVERNMENT OF INDIA (BHARAT SARKAR)
CABINET SECRETARIAT (MANTRIMANDAL SACHIVALAYA)

New Delhi, 14 January, 1980.
24 Pausa, 1901(s).

Subject:- Swearing-in ceremony -

The undersigned is directed to say that the Council of Ministers as shown in Annexure 'A' have relinquished their respective offices with effect from the forenoon of 14th January, 1980.

2. Smt. Indira Gandhi has been sworn-in as the Prime Minister by the President at 10-45 A.M. today, 14th January, 1980, in the Rashtrapati Bhavan. Other Ministers sworn-in by the President at 10-45 A.M. today, 14th January, 1980 are shown at Annexure 'B'.

3. Ministry of Home Affairs may kindly take such action as may be considered necessary regarding issue of Gazette Notifications, etc.

(c) (K. Hamish)
Deputy Secretary to the Cabinet.

To
Ministry of Home Affairs
(Shri B.G. Deshmukh - Additional Secretary)

Copy forwarded for information to:-
(i) Lok Sabha Secretariat
(Shri A.S. Rikhy - Secretary)
(ii) Rajya Sabha Secretariat
(Shri S.S. Bhalerao - Secretary-General)

(c) (K. Hamish)
Deputy Secretary to the Cabinet.
